crossRefs.note: He entered into a boat, and crossed over, and came into his own city.
Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic…
Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.

translations.web: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.
translations.bsb: Then a paralytic was brought to Him, carried by four men.
translations.kjv: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.
translations.asv: And they come, bringing unto him a man sick of the palsy, borne of four.
